metadata.purpose: Preserve every emission moment but replace each input with the same captured constant.

conditions: Exactly one output next for each source next while live.
Each output value is exactly the captured R reference, not a clone.
No extra time, subscription, sharing or scheduler policy.
Cω describes next cardinality. Error, complete, cancellation, and resource release are separate events.

scope.parameters: One captured constant, including undefined or object identities. Deprecated operator export in RxJS 7.8.2.
scope.callbacks: Internally implemented by map(() => value); modeled as no external variable callback.
scope.time: Every output has the arrival time of its source next.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant source and callback-outcome steps. User observers may not synchronously re-enter the modeled execution.
exclusions: Callback binding and operator-construction anomalies; observer reentrancy.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Acquire one upstream subscription only when the resulting Observable is subscribed.

ownership.sharing: No sharing, replay, or global storage; every output subscription has an independent machine.
ownership.reset: Fresh state on each output subscription; Closed rejects later events.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Commit state, then deliver ordered next/terminal/connection actions. Callback outcomes are supplied externally.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between resolved source events; silence on cancellation.

inputs.description: source failure with original error identity

controls.description: description exists, source is not yet connected
completed, failed or cancelled; no later events are legal

rules.explanation: Constant is captured at operator construction, independent source execution starts on subscription.
No input payload is inspected and the constant is not cloned or invoked.
Cancellation does not emit the constant.
